subject: Handoff: Implementation plan & MAP for Seven Hills rollout
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@sevenhills.io>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@sevenhills.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Implementation plan & MAP for Seven Hills rollout

Hi Liam and Priya,

Congrats again on the go-live decision — excited to get started. Per our handoff conversation, I'm looping in our Customer Success and onboarding lead, Marissa, and your AE Rishi to coordinate the implementation. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a proposed milestone timeline. Key points: 

- Proposed kickoff: 2026-06-22 (virtual, 60 min)
- Phase 1: sandbox/trial integration (2 weeks) — engineering/setup tasks
- Phase 2: pilot/validation (3 weeks) — quality checks and evaluation prompts
- Production cutover target: 2026-07-20

Attachments: MAP_SevenHills_v1.xlsx (milestones + owners), SevenHills_kickoff_agenda.pdf (draft agenda)

Ask: Please confirm the kickoff date window and any required legal/PO milestones on your side so we can lock a timeline.

Marissa — can you take the lead on the kickoff and own milestone tracking? Rishi — I'll hand off the operational items after kickoff.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126

- We have a leadership review the week of 6/21; would it be possible to move the kickoff to 6/24 (afternoon PT)?
- Procurement needs to finish PO approval before any production cutover; currently estimating sign-off by 7/10. Can we target a production window 7/22–7/26 instead of 7/20?

Liam and I will confirm internal attendees for the kickoff once leadership timing is firm.

Updated milestone (summary):
- 2026-06-24: Kickoff (Marissa lead) — review goals, success metrics, attendees
- 2026-06-25 to 2026-07-08: Sandbox & integration (Grace runs provisioning)
- 2026-07-09 to 2026-07-16: Pilot & validation (Seven Hills validation window)
- 2026-07-22 to 2026-07-26: Production cutover window (final checks + go/no-go)
- 2026-08-02: Post-launch retrospective and ops handoff

Action items assigned in MAP_SevenHills_v1.xlsx (updated):
- Grace O'Connor: infra, KMS key rotation, access grants
- Marissa Cole: MAP owner & acceptance criteria tracking
- Rishi Malhotra: technical runbook delivery (by 6/23)
- Vanessa Ortiz: commercial/contract checkpoint and billing confirmation

I attached the kickoff agenda and updated MAP. Please review before the meeting; I'll record attendance and Decisions/Actions in the shared Drive folder.
